title: Retrieved craft revealed unknown propulsion

tellings.quote: In one way we have learned that some types of propulsion for example exist that we did never never envisioned never conceived.

plain: Studying craft that the government recovered taught the US about kinds of propulsion "we did never, never envision, never conceived." A former presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren tells Michels this, citing Philip J. Corso, a man who has also said he handled such material. If true, the recovered objects would hold technology beyond anything humans had imagined.
